description: PG&E E-ELEC Residential TOU rate plan updated for 2026 tariff with Profile Metric architecture updates

description: CPAU E-1 Residential Electric Service with tiered pricing
notes: Municipal utility tiered rate plan with unbundled commodity/distribution/public benefits components and ServiceTier definitions. First URPX test case for usage tiers (non-TOU).

description: CPAU E-1 TOU Residential Electric Time of Use Service
notes: Municipal TOU rate with 3 tiers (peak/off-peak/super off-peak) x 2 seasons. Commodity varies by TOU period; distribution and public benefits are flat. Interesting contrast with PG&E E-ELEC TOU structure.
